title: Curriculum Mapping
description: One row of the thin per-country mapping layer (core design doc §1.4). Mappings point at (skill, depth) so spiral curricula fit one canonical node; a skill may have several mapping rows per country, one per grade that touches it.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. IN.

curriculum.description: Curriculum identifier, e.g. NCERT, CC (Common Core), UK_NC, SG.

grade.description: Grade of treatment on the K-10 platform (0 = Kindergarten; the §1.4 example uses grade 6 for NCERT).

depth_expectation.description: How far this grade takes the skill; v1 uses tier labels over the D ∈ [0,1] scalar (§1.4, §2.3). This is the engine's DEFAULT serving ceiling, not absolute — mastering the top of a band opens the next band (self-extending, §1.4).

syllabus_ref.description: Syllabus citation, e.g. "Class 6, Maths, Ch. 7" or "5.NF.A.1".

learning_objective.description: The curriculum's own phrasing of the outcome (§1.4).

exam_contexts.description: Rigor wrappers this skill is served under in this curriculum (§2.10), e.g. SCHOOL_EXAM, OLYMPIAD_IMO_L1.

terminology_overrides.description: Curriculum-specific phrasing, canonical term → local term (§1.4), e.g. {"simplest form": "lowest form"} for NCERT.

pedagogy_notes.description: How this curriculum teaches the method; consumed by lesson drafting (§6.3) and by pedagogy-variant solution steps (§2.2).
